$comment: ERP Copilot tool manifest — the single source of truth for the assistant's tools. Read by ToolRegistry (com.erp.assistant.application) and, in future, shared with a standalone mcp-server. Each tool maps to one ERP REST endpoint. See ToolManifest's javadoc for the input->HTTP mapping rules. Descriptions are hand-written for the LLM; write tools state they require explicit user confirmation. 'requiredRoles' is optional (omit ⇒ any authenticated/role-holding caller); when present the caller must hold at least one of the listed ROLE_* authorities.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: List the item master (products, raw materials, finished goods) with their id, sku, name, item type, unit of measure and standard cost. Use this to resolve a human sku or product name to the numeric item id required by other tools such as create_sales_order. Returns every item; filter the result yourself.

tools.name: search_partners
tools.description: List business partners (customers and vendors) with their id, code, name and vendor/customer flags. Pass vendor=true to list only vendors, or customer=true to list only customers; omit both to list all. Use this to resolve a customer name or code to the numeric partnerId required by create_sales_order.

vendor.description: When true, return only partners flagged as vendors.

customer.description: When true, return only partners flagged as customers.

tools.name: get_inventory_status
tools.description: Get the on-hand status of every stocked item: sku, name, item type, on-hand quantity, on-hand value and a stock-health flag (OK, LOW or OUT). Use this to answer questions about what is in stock, low stock or out of stock.

tools.name: get_ar_aging
tools.description: Get the accounts-receivable aging report as of a date: outstanding customer balances bucketed as current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ days past due, plus the total. Use this to answer questions about overdue receivables and collections.

asOf.description: As-of date in ISO yyyy-MM-dd form. Omit for today.

tools.name: get_kpi_summary
tools.description: Get the finance KPI summary for the current month versus the previous month: revenue, gross profit and net cash, each with current value, previous value and percent change. Use this to answer questions about headline financial performance and month-over-month trends.

asOf.description: Reference date in ISO yyyy-MM-dd form; the month it falls in is the current month. Omit for today.

tools.name: get_reconciliation_health
tools.description: Get the reconciliation health-check: whether the general ledger's trial balance balances and every subledger (AP, AR, inventory) equals its GL control account, with per-subledger figures and transitional clearing-account balances. Use this to answer whether the books are in balance and correct.

asOf.description: As-of date in ISO yyyy-MM-dd form. Omit for today.

tools.name: get_income_statement
tools.description: Get the income statement as of a date: revenue and expense lines, their totals, and net income (totalRevenue - totalExpenses). Call this twice with two different asOf dates (e.g. end of this month and end of last month) to compare periods, such as explaining a change in gross profit or net income.

asOf.description: As-of date in ISO yyyy-MM-dd form. Omit for today.

tools.name: get_general_ledger
tools.description: Get the posted journal-line drill-down for one GL account (entry id/no, posting date, debit, credit, memo, source document) as of a date. Use this to drill into the detail behind a suspicious or unbalanced figure — e.g. a reconciliation subledger/clearing-account mismatch found by get_reconciliation_health, or a specific account named in get_income_statement/get_budget_variance. accountCode must be an exact GL account code (e.g. from get_reconciliation_health's subledgerChecks/clearingAccounts or get_budget_variance's lines).

accountCode.description: Exact GL account code to drill into, e.g. "1200" or "2100-GRIR".

asOf.description: As-of date in ISO yyyy-MM-dd form. Omit for today.

tools.name: get_revenue_trend
tools.description: Get the monthly revenue trend: for each of the last N months, revenue, cost of goods sold (cogs) and the resulting gross margin (revenue - cogs). Use this to explain how revenue or gross margin moved month over month, e.g. to attribute a margin change to a revenue change versus a COGS change.

months.description: Number of trailing months to return, ending at asOf. Omit for the default (6).

asOf.description: Reference date in ISO yyyy-MM-dd form; the trend ends in the month it falls in. Omit for today.

tools.name: get_cash_flow
tools.description: Get the monthly cash-flow trend: for each of the last N months, cash inflow (cash-account debits), outflow (cash-account credits) and the net change. Use this to answer questions about cash movement and liquidity trends, distinct from accrual profit.

months.description: Number of trailing months to return, ending at asOf. Omit for the default (6).

asOf.description: Reference date in ISO yyyy-MM-dd form; the trend ends in the month it falls in. Omit for today.

tools.name: get_budget_variance
tools.description: Get budget-vs-actual for one month: for each budgeted GL account, the budgeted figure, the actual posted movement, and the variance (actual - budget). Use this to answer which accounts are over or under budget and by how much.

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2026. Omit to use asOf's (or today's) year.

month.description: Month number 1-12. Omit to use asOf's (or today's) month.

asOf.description: Reference date in ISO yyyy-MM-dd form, used to default year/month when they are omitted. Omit for today.

tools.name: create_sales_order
tools.description: Create a new DRAFT sales order for a customer. This is a WRITE action and requires explicit user confirmation before it runs; it does not post any accounting entries (the order stays in DRAFT until separately confirmed). Before calling this, resolve the customer to a partnerId with search_partners and each product to an itemId with search_items — never guess ids. Provide partnerId, an orderDate and at least one line, each with itemId, qtyOrdered and unitPrice.

partnerId.description: Numeric id of the customer partner (from search_partners).

orderDate.description: Order date in ISO yyyy-MM-dd form.

itemId.description: Numeric id of the item (from search_items).
